messages:
oliver: Quick question — I renewed my Priority Pass annual membership yesterday ($399) and booked a couple of trips on the same card. Can I expense the membership under travel/homeoffice? I didn’t buy it on the corp card since the provider didn’t accept it. attaching receipt: prioritypass_2026-04-01.pdf :paperclip:

sophia: Hi @oliver — generally we only reimburse memberships that are business-required. Travel perks like lounge memberships are usually personal unless you get manager pre-approval. Did you get approval from your manager before purchase? :thinking:

oliver: No, I didn’t loop Ryan before buying. I travel ~8x/yr for customer meetings, thought it’d be reasonable. If we need a manager sign-off retroactively, what’s the process?

ryan: @oliver I’m fine approving retroactively given travel frequency. Please submit an expense with the receipt and put my name as approver in the form. If finance needs more, mark it as "manager-approved exception" in the notes. :thumbsup:

emma: People Ops / policy note — we don’t have a blanket policy covering lounge memberships. For consistency we need a short rationale (customer travel frequency + average trip >4h or overnight). Add dates of trips in the past 6 months to the expense so we can tie usage to business need.

travel-bot: Automated reminder: Expense policy requires either (a) corporate card purchase or (b) manager approval. Upload receipt and proof of business trips to avoid delays. See link: https://redwood.company/policies/expenses :link:

oliver: Thanks all — added trip dates and attached boarding passes in the expense form. Marked exception and put Ryan as approver.

finance-bot: Expense #EXP-2026-0412 submitted by oliver pending approval. Estimated processing ETA: 5 business days. If flagged for policy review, finance will follow up here.

sophia: Thanks @oliver. Finance will process once Ryan approves. If we see a growing number of these requests we’ll propose a short policy addendum for recurring travelers.

oliver: Good plan. Appreciate the quick help. :raised_hands:
